snippet.title: Killing Momentum: Umbral Moon - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
You are the commander, and your choices define your fate. Lead warriors on a perilous journey under the ghastly Umbral Moon. Defeat brutal enemies in tactical combat where momentum is everything. Brave deadly narrative encounters and manage the volatile bonds of your team of misfits to survive.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4117250/Killing_Momentum_Umbral_Moon/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
